items.title: Dollar General (DG) Increased Traffic 2% and Expanded Gross Margin. How Much Improvement Was Temporary?
items.summary: Dollar General Corporation (NYSE:DG) reported a quarter that combined stronger customer demand with a large temporary margin benefit. Second-quarter net sales increased 5.2% to $11.3 billion. Same-store sales increased 3.5%, reflecting a 2.0% increase in customer traffic and a 1.5% increase in average transaction amount.
